title: The Drag: Austin Music Culture and History Walking Tour
includes: Guided walking tour led by a local Austin musician
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the rich music culture and history in Austin with a guided walking tour led by local musician Meredith Scottie Welborn. Stroll through The Drag and visit iconic venues while learning about the artists and characters who shaped the city into the Live Music Capital of the World. This engaging tour covers about 1.5 miles and is perfect for both first-time visitors and longtime residents. Gain unique insights into Austin's rich musical heritage and appreciate the stories that resonate within its streets.

- Guided walking tour covering 1.5 miles through Austin's music culture
- Led by local musician and storyteller Meredith Scottie Welborn
- All ages welcome, perfect for music lovers and history buffs alike
